name: Jagannath University
about: Jagannath University is a public university in Old Dhaka, near the Buriganga river. It traces its roots to Dhaka Brahma School (1858), later Jagannath School and then Jagannath College (1884), and became a public university under the Jagannath University Act 2005. It has 7 faculties, 38 departments and 2 institutes; a 200-acre new campus in Keraniganj is under construction.
